arabic text: Akbar tumhe maloom hai kya maangrahé ho\nTum baap sé marné ki reza maang rahé ho
english translation text: Akbar, do you realise what you are asking?\nYou are asking your father for permission to die

arabic text:
Is aalame ghurbat mein tumhe jaane doon kaise
Is dashte musibat mein tumhe jaane doon kaise
Is waqté kayamat mein tumhe jaane doon kaise
Ay laal jo tum izné wighaa maang rahé ho
english translation text:
How can I allow you to go in this state of loneliness?
How can I send you into this desert of calamity?
How can I let you go at this hour of Judgement?
O my son, you are asking permission for battle

arabic text:
Kya guzrégi iss baap ké dil par nahin socha
Tumné yé meri jaan ali akbar nahin socha
Mar jaunga main tujhse bichhad kar nahi socha
Tum mujhse zaeefi ka asaa maang rahe ho
english translation text:
Have you not considered what will pass through your father's heart?
O Ali Akbar, my life, have you not thought of this?
Have you not thought that I will die after separation from you?
You are asking me for the staff of my old age

arabic text:
Dil rota hain nazron sé agar door ho béta
Kis tarha judaai teri manzoor ho béta
Tum hi méri ankhein ho méra noor ho béta
Mujhsé méri ankhon ki ziya maang rahe ho
english translation text:
My heart weeps whenever you leave my sight;
my son, how can I accept separation from you?
You are my eyes, you are my light.
You ask me for the brightness of my eyes

arabic text:
Duniya sé gaya jis ghadi mehboob khuda ka
Nana ki ziyarat ko tadapta tha nawassa
Aye laal tujhé is liyé khaalik sé tha manga
Maqbool huwi méri dua maang rahe ho
english translation text:
When God's beloved departed this world,
his grandson longed to visit his grandfather.
My son, for this reason I had prayed to the Creator for you;
you now ask for the fulfilment of my accepted prayer

arabic text:
Islam pé khud apna lahoo rann mein bahao
Siné pé sina shaan sé maidaan mein khaao
Tasweer payambar ki tahé khaak milao
Kya is liyé marné ki riza maang rahe ho

Ek roz tujhé aan ké manga tha phuphi né
Atthara baras naazon sé paala tha phuphi né
Béton sé bhi zyada tumhé chaha tha phuphi né
Ehsaan jo zainab né kiya maang rahé ho

Rakhté nahi tum iski khabar aye méré pyaré
Kis darja mohabbat hai téri dil mein humaaré
Nana ki méré shakl hai paikar mein tumharé
Tum sooraté mehboobé khuda maang rahé ho
english translation text:
My beloved, you do not understand
how deeply we love you.
In your form lives the face of my grandfather.
You are asking for the likeness of God's beloved

arabic text:
Sar tera bhi jiss waqt chadhega sare naiza
Hoga saré maidaan juda sar bhi tumhara
Hum shaklé payambar ka gala kaaténgée aadaa
Goya méré nana ka gala maang rahé ho
english translation text:
When your head too is raised upon the spear,
and your head is separated in the battlefield,
the enemies will cut the throat of the Prophet's likeness.
It will be as though they cut my grandfather's throat

arabic text: Baba mujhé maloom hai kya maang raha hoon\nEk baap sé marné ki riza maang raha hoon
english translation text: Baba, I know what I am asking;\nI am asking a father for permission to die

arabic text:
Baba mujhé Amma ne bhi kuch dars diya hai
Adab é wafa sé mujhé aagah kiya hai
Pehlé mein maru aap sé wada yé liya hai
Buss is liyé marné ki riza maang raha hoon
Ek baap se marne ki riza maang raha hun...
Baba mujhe maaloom hai kya maang raha hun
english translation text:
Baba, my mother has also taught me lessons;
she has instructed me in the manners of loyalty.
She took a promise that I would die before you.
This is why I ask permission to die.
I ask a father for permission to die...
Baba, I know what I am asking

arabic text:
Hai aap to baba biné khaatooné qayamat
Aur maa hai méri apna si ék pehkaré ismat
Kya siné mein us pé nahin kuch jalbahé ismat
Mein madaré muztar ka kaha maang raha hoon
Ek baap se marne ki riza maang raha hun...
Baba mujhe maaloom hai kya maang raha hun
english translation text:
You are the son of the Lady of Judgement,
and my mother is herself a perfect image of purity.
Does that purity not also shine within my heart?
I ask only what my grieving mother instructed.
I ask a father for permission to die...
Baba, I know what I am asking

arabic text:
Baba mujhé ehwaalé dilé zaar pata hai
Hai sakht bohat manzilé dushwaar pata hai
Aur deen ka mushkil mein hai sardaar pata hai
Yun aap sé marné ki riza mangu raha hoon
Ek baap se marne ki riza mangu raha hun
english translation text:
Baba, I know the state of your grieving heart;
I know how severe and difficult this stage is.
I also know the leader of the faith is in hardship.
That is why I ask you for permission to die.
I ask a father for permission to die
